description: This PHP class 'Book' generates HTML documentation pages, including table of contents, cover, and content pages, based on a directory tree structure and configuration.

classes.name: Book
classes.description: A class for generating HTML documentation pages from a directory tree and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Book with a directory tree and configuration.

methods.name: getStyles
methods.description: Retrieves and concatenates CSS styles from theme files.

methods.name: getPageUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL fragment for a page based on its URL.

methods.name: buildNavigation
methods.description: Recursively builds navigation structure from directory tree.

methods.name: generateTOC
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the table of contents.

methods.name: generateCover
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the cover page.

methods.name: generatePages
methods.description: Generates HTML for all added pages.

methods.name: addPage
methods.description: Adds a page with content to the book.
